title: DesignManager: An Agent-Powered Copilot for Designers to Integrate AI Design Tools into Creative Workflows
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper introduces DesignManager, an AI-powered copilot system for designers to integrate AI tools into their workflows. It includes formative studies, technical evaluations, and an open-ended user study with designers to assess system effectiveness.
